## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows gitflow (`feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`, `chore/*` → `develop`; `release/*`, `hotfix/*` → `main`)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `just ci` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs, `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased), `CLAUDE.md` and skills updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, no files from `temp/`, no PRD files
- [ ] Every new fact, image or video has a source
